findings.highlight: She has to absorb other people’s magical energy to survive
findings.evidenceJa: マスターであるかぎり、[ruby text=よそ o2o=1]他人から魔力を取らないとやっていけない体
findings.governingReading: As long as Sakura remains a Master, her body cannot continue without taking magical energy from others.
findings.explanation: The English removes Rin’s condition tying the need to Sakura’s continuing Master status and weakens the bodily constraint.

findings.highlight: kill her here and minimize the number of victims
findings.evidenceJa: ここで終わらせた方が犠牲がでない
findings.governingReading: Ending Sakura’s life here would mean no victims emerge.
findings.explanation: The English changes Rin’s claimed zero-victim solution into accepting a reduced number of victims.

findings.evidenceJa: 一縷の希望
findings.governingReading: a single slender thread of hope
findings.explanation: The English labels the hope already hopeless, making Rin’s criticism more categorical than the source.

findings.evidenceJa: 打算と妥協にまみれた失策
findings.governingReading: failures mired in calculation and compromise
findings.explanation: The English collapses Rin’s two-part ethical criticism into selfishness alone.

findings.highlight: I have always tried to deny
findings.evidenceJa: 衛[ruby text=おれ char=2]宮士郎
findings.governingReading: Emiya Shirou in the written text, read as “I,” has always denied it.
findings.explanation: The English preserves only the first-person ruby and removes Shirou naming his constructed identity as the subject.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=げんじつ char=2]過去
findings.governingReading: the past, read as reality
findings.explanation: The English preserves only “reality” and deletes the written “past,” losing the equation between Kiritsugu’s history and Shirou’s accepted reality.

findings.highlight: you’re going to be blown away
findings.evidenceJa: 根元から吹っ飛ばされて外まで転がり出る
findings.governingReading: He will be blasted away from the base and sent rolling all the way outside.
findings.explanation: The English removes the threat’s bodily trajectory and force.

findings.evidenceJa: 売り言葉に買い言葉
findings.governingReading: They have answered provocation with provocation.
findings.explanation: An escalating exchange of hostile words becomes neutral reciprocity.

findings.evidenceJa: おまえに話しておかなければならない
findings.governingReading: Kirei must tell Shirou because Rin left without hearing it.
findings.explanation: The English makes the required recipient arbitrary, weakening why Kirei stops Shirou.

findings.highlight: It’s like pulling out four-tenths of her nerves
findings.evidenceJa: 神経の四割を生きたまま引き抜く
findings.governingReading: It would pull out forty percent of her nerves while she is alive.
findings.explanation: The English turns Kirei’s literal procedural description into a comparison and omits Sakura being alive during it.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=サーヴァント char=4]己が機能の維持
findings.governingReading: maintain her own function, read as “Servant”
findings.explanation: The English preserves only the ruby and deletes the claim that Sakura sacrifices people to maintain her own functioning.

findings.highlight: as though I’m looking into a strobe lamp
findings.evidenceJa: ストロボをあてられたような
findings.governingReading: as though a strobe had flashed directly on him
findings.explanation: A sudden imposed flash becomes Shirou voluntarily looking into a lamp.

findings.highlight: I can barely stand under the impact of his words
findings.evidenceJa: 神父の言葉は痛すぎて、よろめかないように踏み止まるのが精一杯
findings.governingReading: Kirei’s words hurt so much that Shirou can only brace himself to keep from staggering.
findings.explanation: The English removes both explicit pain and Shirou’s deliberate effort not to stagger.

findings.highlight: He must understand, because he nods slightly
findings.evidenceJa: 納得がいったのか、ヤツはわずかに首を傾けた
findings.governingReading: Perhaps persuaded, Kirei tilts his head slightly.
findings.explanation: The English promotes Shirou’s inference to certainty and reverses an ambiguous head tilt into an affirmative nod.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜を引き止める
findings.governingReading: Shirou must stop or hold Sakura back.
findings.explanation: The immediate protective aim changes from restraining Sakura’s flight to merely locating her.

findings.evidenceJa: その体温を確かめたかった
findings.governingReading: He wants to take Sakura’s hand and check her body temperature.
findings.explanation: The English turns a concrete check of her fever into a generalized desire for warmth.

findings.highlight: If you needed to find shelter where there weren’t any people
findings.evidenceJa: 雨の凌げる場所で、人気のない所といったら
findings.governingReading: A place sheltered from rain and deserted—where would that be?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s location-specific search thought becomes an awkward generic second-person hypothetical.

findings.evidenceJa: 深山町
findings.governingReading: Miyama Town
findings.explanation: The English changes the named district’s administrative and spatial scale from town to city.

findings.highlight: exposing her body to the rain
findings.evidenceJa: 凍えた雨に体を[ruby text=さら]晒していた
findings.governingReading: Sakura stands with her body exposed to the freezing rain.
findings.explanation: The English removes the freezing cold and risks a sexual reading of “exposing her body.”

findings.evidenceJa: 今まで聞いた事のない必死さ
findings.governingReading: a desperation Shirou has never before heard from Sakura
findings.explanation: The English uses awkward diction and changes the evidence from something heard in Sakura’s voice to something seen.

findings.highlight: a criminal mortified by her actions
findings.evidenceJa: 己を恥じる罪人
findings.governingReading: a sinner ashamed of herself
findings.explanation: The English specifies regret over actions rather than Sakura’s shame toward her own being.

findings.evidenceJa: 決して、近づいてはいけない
findings.governingReading: He senses that he must never approach until Sakura raises her face herself.
findings.explanation: The English omits the action and the absolute force of Shirou respecting Sakura’s boundary.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜に手を差し伸べる
findings.governingReading: Shirou can only extend a hand to Sakura from where he stands.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the restrained offered hand and omits Sakura as its explicit recipient.

findings.highlight: Her voice is heavy with self-loathing
findings.evidenceJa: 憎しみの混じった声
findings.governingReading: Sakura spits the words out clearly in a voice mixed with hatred.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the hatred specifically to Sakura herself and omits the forceful delivery.

findings.evidenceJa: 先輩が思ってるような女の子じゃないんですよ
findings.governingReading: Sakura says she is not the kind of girl Shirou thinks she is.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces Sakura’s relational self-image with virginity and later invents a long-past “first time.”

findings.highlight: I was raped at the place I was adopted as a kid
findings.evidenceJa: 小さい頃からよくわからないものに触られてきました
findings.governingReading: Since childhood at the place she was taken in, Sakura has been touched by things she did not understand.
findings.explanation: The mature branch resolves deliberately limited child-perspective knowledge into categorical rape and adds sexual chronology.

findings.evidenceJa: 小さい頃からよくわからないものに触られてきました
findings.governingReading: has been continuously touched
findings.explanation: The base branch contains a plainly duplicated “been.”

findings.evidenceJa: 自虐的な行為
findings.governingReading: a self-punishing or self-destructive act
findings.explanation: The English gives Sakura’s self-directed punishment a sexual or pleasure-bearing “masochistic” framing unsupported here.

findings.evidenceJa: 毒でもなんでもない、暗示のようなもの
findings.governingReading: It was neither poison nor anything similar, only something like suggestion.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces the weak mental suggestion with a bodily aphrodisiac and invented heightened sensitivity.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分が分からなくなって
findings.governingReading: made Sakura lose her grasp of herself
findings.explanation: The English pathologizes a loss of self-recognition as generic madness.

findings.evidenceJa: 卑怯者です
findings.governingReading: I am a cowardly or dishonorable person.
findings.explanation: The English changes Sakura’s self-accusation from cowardice and moral dishonor to selfishness.

findings.evidenceJa: よけい悲しくなっている
findings.governingReading: makes her even sadder
findings.explanation: The English substitutes an outward degree of crying for Sakura’s worsening internal sadness.

findings.highlight: Feeling her pain, I regret what I’ve done
findings.evidenceJa: それを感じ取って、後悔した
findings.governingReading: Perceiving that Sakura can only cry by blaming herself, Shirou regrets not understanding sooner.
findings.explanation: The English invents pain as the perceived object and an unspecified deed as the object of regret.

findings.highlight: I could go crazy any minute now
findings.evidenceJa: いつさっきみたいに取り乱すかわからなくて
findings.governingReading: She does not know when she may lose control again as she did earlier.
findings.explanation: The English turns a repeatable loss of composure into madness.

findings.highlight: someone to lead her by force
findings.evidenceJa: 強引に手を引っ張ってくれる人
findings.governingReading: someone who will forcefully take her hand and pull her onward
findings.explanation: The English removes the concrete hand-taking Sakura asked for and can imply generalized coercion.

findings.highlight: Every day I thought about ending it all
findings.evidenceJa: こんなのは今日限りにして
findings.governingReading: She would end this relationship as of today and pretend to be a stranger beginning tomorrow.
findings.explanation: The English adds daily repetition and the dangerous ambiguity of suicidal “ending it all.”

findings.highlight: put a knife on my wrist
findings.evidenceJa: 死のうって決めた時
findings.governingReading: when Sakura decided to die
findings.explanation: The mature branch invents a specific wrist-and-knife suicide action absent from Sakura’s statement.

findings.highlight: I knew I would stop crying at night
findings.evidenceJa: これ以上は悲しくなくなるって、これ以上泣かなくていい
findings.governingReading: She believed she would no longer be this sad and would not have to cry any more.
findings.explanation: The English omits relief from sadness and invents nighttime as the limit on her crying.

findings.evidenceJa: 冷え切った体
findings.governingReading: her body chilled completely through
findings.explanation: The English weakens Sakura’s dangerous degree of exposure.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜だけの正義の味方
findings.governingReading: a champion of justice for Sakura alone
findings.explanation: The English loses both the exclusivity of Shirou choosing Sakura and the explicit transformation of his justice ideal.

findings.highlight: The stubbornness flows out of Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: あれだけ冷たく、頑なだった桜の肩から力が抜けていた
findings.governingReading: The strength leaves Sakura’s shoulders, which had been so cold and rigid.
findings.explanation: The English makes physical and emotional rigidity a personality fault and omits her coldness.

findings.evidenceJa: 肌の熱さ
findings.governingReading: the heat of Sakura’s skin
findings.explanation: The English turns feverish skin heat into comforting warmth and renders physical contact as vague “sensation.”

findings.evidenceJa: 一つの選択が終わった
findings.governingReading: one choice has ended
findings.explanation: The English reframes the ending or foreclosure of a path as the affirmative making of a choice.

findings.highlight: if this is love or not
findings.evidenceJa: 恋というものなのか、愛というものなのか
findings.governingReading: whether this is romantic love or selfless/deeper love
findings.explanation: The English collapses the explicit distinction between 恋 and 愛 into love versus no love.

findings.highlight: the end of this love will not be compensation
findings.evidenceJa: この恋の終わりは、報われるものではない
findings.governingReading: the end of this love will not be rewarded or requited
findings.explanation: The English produces a nonsensical financial “compensation” reading for emotional fulfillment.
